title: C1458 – Accelerometer Front Circuit Short To Battery
description: Accelerometer Front Circuit Short To Battery Diagnostic trouble code C1458. Confirm with a scan tool and vehicle-specific service data.

Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
